## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Every atom of CAP, LO, AW, RPU (rule heads, baselines, all 22 declared factor ladders incl. untriggered tiers, assemblies, overwrites/retired surface, three prerequisites, tool contracts) and of the governing base policies is carried at the same strength; no normative claim lacks a source. Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts): (a) whole_evt_policy_loan's accrual clause is retired while its own formula `accrued_loan_interest` (tier rate, /365) remains in force for loan value — rendered faithfully as both; any tension is in the source. (b) whole_grace_apl_and_nonforfeiture keeps NCV = GCV + PUA CV + accumulations − loan and its RPU face formula for the default nonforfeiture occasion, distinct from the extended election basis — rendered as in force, correctly. (c) Base whole_reduced_paid_up_election sentence "Any loan is extinguished against the cash value first" is a base ordering rule rendered verbatim (reduced_paid_up_and_automatic_premium_loan_elections) — recorded here, not judged under dependency_form. (d) No document states in words whether a loan repayment entry's `amount` is the principal part; the record loan balance and the source compute agree that it is.
